title: Symmetry of affine sign-form absolute moments
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $a_0\in\mathbb{R}$ and let $a_1,\ldots,a_n\in\mathbb{R}$. If $X$ is uniform on the sign cube and $L(X)=\sum_{i=1}^n a_iX_i$, then $\mathbb{E}|-a_0+L(X)|=\mathbb{E}|a_0+L(X)|$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is a real coefficient vector indexed by $1,\ldots,n$
